verdict.rationale: Render supports versioning infrastructure/automations as code via a single YAML file, git-based deploys on every push, and explicit rollback functionality, covering the version and rollback parts of the story. Review workflows (e.g., PR-based approval before deploy) are not explicitly documented, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback reliability. missing for 10: explicit review/approval workflow evidence, independent verification of rollback behavior in production.
